residuals.title: Actor/source qualification
residuals.defect: Profiles lacked source-bound legal acquisition/preparation histories, class engine, derived resources, conditions, repertoires and spell histories. RP exceeded Mage maxima (60 vs 50 at level17; 40 vs 26 at level9), and standing 5 exceeded the ordinary -3..+3 range.
residuals.required: Use the exact Mage table and bind full TEST_ONLY caster profiles; Mage17 RP 50->24, Mage9 RP 26->16; use sourced valid standing.

residuals.title: Actual casting predicates
residuals.defect: Gate/Champion casts lacked V/S/F availability, identified held focus and hand custody, Gate caster position/range/LoE, Champion Action consumption, Conjuration/class history, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration and participant Counterspell eligibility/decision.
residuals.required: Record commitment, windows and resolution, spell components, focus custody, distances, source-bound spell access, class history and every participant's selected Mage Counterspell eligibility/decision.

residuals.title: Scheduled opportunities and command phase
residuals.defect: Regular starts/ends, once-only refreshes, stance choices, allowance expiry and t66 equal-time ordering were absent; attached movement lacked the owner's whole-turn end and phase start/end; command eligibility was not bound.
residuals.required: Replay all six-second turn markers through t66, command predicates/global allowance, turn/phase order, and expiration of unused movement.

residuals.title: Cargo custody and occupied geometry
residuals.defect: Hand snapshot contradicted carriedSlot and no numeric cargo envelope/offset, full admission sweep, cell-local map or BAN-CELL-03 dimensions were present.
residuals.required: Bind one consistent hand/custody record, occupied item volume and offset, full body/cargo sweep, cell-local mapping and numeric bounds.

residuals.title: Wrong fixed origin anchor
residuals.defect: The cell anchor was portal-plane [100,100,0], but the recorded admission endpoint was [105,100,0].
residuals.required: Fix the anchor at the actual admission endpoint and recompute all projections and receipts.

residuals.title: Placement conclusions lack geometry
residuals.defect: Placement forks used occupancy booleans and grid centers without occupant volumes, barrier/support geometry, lantern fit, displacement or unobstructed-region proof.
residuals.required: Provide continuous TEST_ONLY physical geometry, derive candidate fit/nearest position, and prove no legal adjacent placement in the pending branch without displacement or wall passage.

residuals.title: Broken locators and overstated coverage
residuals.defect: Some source locators were malformed or pointed to nonexistent records, delivery named a staging manifest path, and coverage blurred replay integrity with unresolved semantics.
residuals.required: Use exact JSON pointers plus separate paragraph labels, actual packet member paths, ARCHIVE_MANIFEST.json delivery path, and retain W08 as outstanding until sealed.

lifecycleFinding: The submitted lifecycle ordering correctly removed body/intrinsic gear at t60, retained genuine lantern cargo, kept the cell until t66, destroyed it with pending cargo, and made duplicate closure a no-op. That does not close the seven residuals.
scopeFinding: No AC5-BANISH-EXT/AC5-X17 mechanics or magical endpoint-blocker exception were exercised. W01 stays sealed; W05 follows W08; W03 stays on its separate source HOLD.
